protocol.validation: group K-fold by InChIKey over the scored pool: a fresh permutation of the sorted scored compound keys per repeat, dealt round-robin, whole compounds held out - Week 11's own splitter, reused through masked_splits
protocol.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters
protocol.physical_block: frozen xTB vector with T_K replaced by the observation's T_K
protocol.paired_rule: folds are dealt over the compounds of the scored mask only, so every arm that scores the same rows shares one fold assignment even when its training pool differs - and every arm here scores the same rows
protocol.arm_a: epsilons of the added compounds permuted between compounds, seed 20260926
protocol.arm_b: compound-level subsample at 25/50/75/100% of the added compounds, one shared random compound order so the doses nest, seed 20260927
protocol.arm_c: one mean row per added compound, appended after the observation rows so no index moves

placebo_scope_check.statement: the placebo moves only the epsilons of added compounds, which paired_base can neither score nor fit, so its re-run under the permuted target has to come back bit-identical to the run under the true labels

paired_base.description: train and score on the frozen v11 room-temperature rows, grouped 10x5

paired_plus_coverage.description: train on the v11 room rows plus the room rows of every new compound the frequency gate admitted; score the same frozen v11 room rows on the same folds

paired_plus_new_xtb.description: same scored rows and folds as paired_base, training widened only by the new compounds whose xTB features were computed in this round

paired_plus_v03_block.description: same scored rows and folds as paired_base, training widened only by the new compounds whose features already sat in the frozen v03 block

arm_b_dose_25.description: S-5 arm B at 25% of the 50 added compounds, drawn at the compound level so a compound is wholly in or wholly out

arm_b_dose_50.description: S-5 arm B at 50% of the 50 added compounds, drawn at the compound level so a compound is wholly in or wholly out

arm_b_dose_75.description: S-5 arm B at 75% of the 50 added compounds, drawn at the compound level so a compound is wholly in or wholly out

arm_c_mean_row_only.description: S-5 arm C: each added compound contributes one mean row - its own xTB vector at its mean T_K and its mean epsilon - so the compound count survives and the T resolution does not

arm_c_nearest_real_row.description: S-5 arm C, second reading: each added compound keeps only the existing room row closest to its own mean epsilon, one real row per compound instead of a synthesised mean row

arm_a_reference_base.description: the Week 11 base re-run on the permuted target, to prove the placebo moved only rows that paired_base can neither score nor fit

arm_a_label_placebo.description: S-5 arm A: train on the same 127 added room rows with their epsilons permuted between the added compounds; scored rows, folds, row counts and regularisation unchanged

arm_b_dose.nesting: every dose is a prefix of one shared compound order, so the levels nest

curve.note: monotone reads 单调递增 strictly (every step positive); non_decreasing is the same curve with a float tolerance and is reported beside it

arm_c_mean_row.selection_rule: the real room row whose epsilon is closest to the compound's mean
arm_c_mean_row.tie_break: smallest row index wins an exact tie (argmin over an index-ordered block)

mean_row_augmentation.device: the mean row is appended after the observation rows, so no index moves

fold_contract.basis: the scored rows of every fold, repeat by repeat

criteria.statement: arm A passes when its paired dR2 is at most +0.02; arm B passes when the 25/50/75/100 % curve rises monotonically (every step positive); arm C is a mechanism cross-check and does not enter the pre-registered headline

verdict.headline: 数据量效应，+0.1241 不得对外引用
verdict.statement: Arm B 剂量曲线不是单调递增。因此 W11 的 +0.1241 只能读作数据量/正则化效应，该数字不得对外引用（Arm C 的均值退化只作机制旁证，不参与这条判据）。
